WPMS No. 2190 of 2020 
Hon’ble Ravi Malimath, A.C.J. 
 Shri T.A. Khan, learned senior counsel 
appearing for the petitioner’s counsel Shri 
Mohd. Hasnain Raza. 
 Shri Rajendra Dobhal, learned senior 
counsel appearing for the respondents’ 
counsel Shri Shubhang Dobhal. 
 Call after four weeks to enable 
learned counsel for the respondents to file 
counter affidavit, if any. 
 In the interregnum, the respondents 
are restrained from evicting the petitioner 
from House No. 948, Category 3, which 
was allotted to the father of the petitioner, 
till the next date. 
 Interim relief application (CLMA No. 
9892 of 2020) stands disposed off. 
 
 
(Ravi Malimath) 
 A.C.J. 
 21.11.2020 
R.P.
